basics.name: Yongbo Chen
basics.label: Ph.D. Student in Computer Science, Tulane University
basics.summary: Computer Science Ph.D. student working at the intersection of human-computer interaction, visualization, and software engineering. My research combines qualitative studies, interactive prototyping, and program analysis to help people understand and improve software and data workflows.

work.name: Tulane University
work.summary: Advisor: Rebecca Faust. Research on visual support for debugging data workflows and interactive frameworks for human feedback in text embedding refinement.
highlights: First-author IEEE VIS 2026 short paper on visualization opportunities in data-intensive debugging
Co-author on KeySI, IEEE VIS 2026 full paper
Qualitative interview study with practitioners debugging pandas and computational notebooks

work.name: University of California, Irvine
work.summary: Advisor: Joshua Garcia. Empirical research and tool development on Java module encapsulation abuse.
highlights: Co-authored ICSE 2026 paper on Breaking Strong Encapsulation
Built BEAD, a static-analysis tool detecting JDK-internal API abuse
Master's thesis: Automatic Detection of Breaking Strong Encapsulation in Java Modules (2024)

work.name: Tulane University
work.position: Teaching Assistant, Introduction to Computer Science II (CMPS 1600)

publications.name: Debugging as Evidence-Driven Reasoning: Visualization Opportunities in Data-Intensive Programming
publications.summary: Interview study characterizing debugging in data-intensive programming and deriving visualization design requirements.

publications.name: KeySI: An Interaction Framework for Tuning Text Embeddings Based on Human Feedback
publications.summary: Interactive framework for tuning text embeddings through keyword-based human feedback.

publications.name: Breaking Strong Encapsulation: A Comprehensive Study of Java Module Abuse
publications.summary: Empirical study of Breaking Strong Encapsulation in the Java Platform Module System based on 4,079 GitHub issues.

projects.name: BEAD - Breaking Encapsulation Abuse Detector
projects.summary: Static-analysis tool that detects access to JDK-internal APIs through direct calls and reflection, using JavaParser, Soot, call graphs, and dataflow analysis.

projects.name: CodeMentor: AI-Assisted Programming Education
projects.summary: Interview- and survey-driven design of an LLM-integrated programming tutor, followed by heuristic evaluation, usability testing, and a Node.js prototype.
